slides.texte_overlay:
8 Silent battles men must win
to be GREAT

The battle of comfort.
The warm bed, the easy night,
the safe choice. Comfort feels
like rest until it becomes a cage.

The battle of distraction.
Your phone is designed to win.
Every hour you take back
is an hour you build with.

The battle of anger.
Anyone can explode.
The strong man feels it,
waits, then speaks.

The battle of comparison.
Their highlight reel isn't
your race. Look at who you
were last year instead.

The battle of fear.
Most of what you're afraid of
never happens. Do it scared.

The battle of the past.
You can learn from it
without living in it.

The battle of rest.
Knowing when to stop
is also discipline.
Tired men make bad decisions.

The battle of curiosity.
The day you stop learning,
you start shrinking.
Feed your mind every day.
